name: wave7-local-load-soak
scope: Local single-host createApp with test-double provider + injectable clock for rate-window simulation. Not national-scale.

hardware.note: Recorded on agent box; not a declared competition reference machine profile.

scenario.rate_limit_policy: 20 POST /api/v1/plans per 60s simulated window; 429 expected and clock-advanced

heap_floor.note: process.memoryUsage() only — not Chrome heap or energy. Documented floor for local soak.

g05_acceptance.required: ≥20 concurrent sessions and 1000 synthetic records for 5 minutes; <1% unexpected failures; no lost writes
g05_acceptance.reason: Wave7 soak: 20 concurrent health workers for 300076ms (≥300000ms), 1000 durable audit rows, unexpected_failure_rate=0, lost_writes=0. Heap snapshots recorded.
